newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU's Ajello returns to Great Lakes region.
newsitem.headline: EU's Ajello returns to Great Lakes region.

text.p: European Union special envoy Aldo Ajello has returned to Africa's troubled Great Lakes region to discuss with the Tanzanian authorities ways that Europe can help out in the Zaire crisis, an EU statement said on Wednesday.
Under orders from the Dutch EU Presidency, Ajello started a tour of the region last week during which he met, among others, Zaire rebel leader Laurent Kabila.
The statement said that after visiting Tanzania Ajello would continue consultations with leaders of other countries in the region.

The aim would be "to convey the concern of the European Union on the need for a peaceful transition in Zaire, strict respect for human rights and the safe return to their country of refugees who wish to be repatriated."
It added: "The special envoy will ask the leaders of the region to exercise their influence on the protagonists in pursuit of these objectives."
